criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered and dark (mean mid tone 0.079); slide 1 passes the showstopper test; slides 2 and 8 are true reliefs. Slide 7 is a mid-tone macro with no single subject and no stop bar; slide 3 a thin tan slab under a dead middle, its bars starting at different x; slide 4's markers read as texture and the six amber markers are a few pixels; slide 6's kit person small and mannequin-like.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One material vocabulary, one key casting lower right, value dark with no strobe, the road-paint motif changing state frame by frame. The camera move works only partly because 7 reads as texture; slide 9's slab sits slightly outside the road world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and nothing is fabricated. Looser than the source: slide 5's 'Seven For, seven For, then eight' reads as rising support where each vote was unanimous among those present and the third is for the removal-if-rejected resolution; 'up to 70' puts a ceiling on a count c5 states flatly; 'ADDED IN 2023' rests on 'restated'; slide 8 cites c46's 'down within 72 hours' beside c33's 'start bagging 72 hours after'; c22's stored quote does not carry the verb removal; slide 6 says 'The ballot' where only Harris County's was read.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when are named. The only next-step instruction addresses Harris County's voters while League City sits in Galveston County too and its hours were not read; the caption's closing question goes unanswered.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns a swipe and the close lands; the real turn arrives 6 to 7 though the storyboard declared 5; slide 3 is a defensive frame that could fold into 2.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; good specific lines. Flat spots: slide 1's hook generic, slide 4's 'can look' soft; the first comment's document labels carry non-ordinal dates with the post's own year.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The road-paint system is new; the story is not. No. 4 (2026-08-20) was League City's nonbinding Flock ballot and no. 39 (2026-10-01) printed the same ballot sentence, the November 3rd vote and Kyle and Laredo in May. The October 13th resolution makes this a different topic, so it is not hard-failed.

one_sentence_fix: Make frame 9 and the caption serve every League City voter: state that the city sits in Galveston and Harris counties and say plainly the hours shown are Harris County's.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid-tone macro of beige thermoplastic over most of the lower 60 percent, no single subject, no stop bar.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Yaw the camera about 35 degrees so the bars recede diagonally to the stop bar and the lit terracotta kerb panel; keymask the nearest bar's top into shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A thin tan mid-tone pan under a dead upper middle; the bars start at different x.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera to about 0.9 m and move in until the pan fills about 60 percent of the height; darken the concrete; start both bars on one lit zero saw cut.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 400 markers alias into texture; the six amber markers are a few pixels each.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the eye to about 1.2 m at fov 30, 4 m back, so the amber markers are large in the foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The kit resident small and mannequin-like in a mostly empty road.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the camera to about 6 m and lower it so the resident stands a third of the frame against the lit crosswalk.

notes_for_panel: c22's stored quote lacks the verb removal; confirm the matter title's verb.
No. 39 is inside the window under dedupe_check's arithmetic; run dedupe_check and record it.
The first comment's document labels break the ordinal and own-year date rules.
Slide 1's 'votes Tuesday' is true only if the post goes out before November 3rd.
